contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Dupondius of Antoninus Pius (138-161), mint of Rome issue of 153-154, RIC volume 3 no. 920. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: ANTONINVSAVGP[--]. Reverse description: Libertas standing facing, head right, holding pileus in right hand and left hand extended. S C in field. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin citing Sear volume 2 no. 4279.…
